finding: Four broad-feature variants pass the prespecified internal rank gate, but none can be queried through the current 18-feature paper API without implementing the same expanded causal feature builder. The best student's exact action agreement with hindsight is only 5–14% by fold. Positive oracle actions on 95–97% of eligible minutes are hindsight opportunity, not obtainable live accuracy. Replay profitability, gap concentration, and the reserved holdout remain untested pending global selection.
limitation: The oracle selects the best of eight fixed direction/horizon alternatives after outcomes mature; it is not a literal oracle over every possible exit path. The historical Yahoo contract identity, roll rule, and minute convention remain unverified.
